AirPods Pro 3 with a $50 discount still going strong, Amazon also brings back launch deals on the M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio, and early fall Prime Day deals have been updated with new discounts. Today's Lunch Break at 9to5Toys also features the all-time low $200 discount on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance at Amazon, an exclusive deal on iPhone 18 Pro cases, all-new SANDMARC 3-in-1 anti-glare, exposure, and diffusion filters (for iPhone 18 Pro), and more. Don't miss the newly released Beats 360 ANC over-ear headphones, as well as 20% off Cushion Kits modular accessories.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance deal lands at Amazon with all-time low near $200 off

We're still tracking early-bird deals from the Apple Watch Ultra 4 launch week (find them below), but Amazon now has a brand new all-time low on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance—the models with Natural and Black Milanese Loop are now nearly $200 off their regular prices.

Amazon has now cut the Black Titanium and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Titanium Milanese Loop down to $699.97 with free shipping.

These configurations are the same as the Ultra 4 model, which sells for $899, and both have just hit their all-time lowest prices at Amazon:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (regularly $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (regularly $899)

Before Amazon's clearance deal today, we have never seen either model dip below $749, and drops below $800 have been exceedingly rare—only reaching that level once previously.

The Apple Watch Ultra 4 does offer a number of notable upgrades and improvements, but in my view, the third generation remains a capable wearable for everyone except the most hardcore Ultra users and fitness enthusiasts. Our Apple Watch Ultra 4 vs Ultra 3 comparison article has all the details.

New M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio launch deals now live with up to nearly $50 off

Apple has officially launched its latest display-less desktop machines, including the 2026 M6 Mac mini and M5 Max Mac Studio. Amazon has also brought back launch deals, knocking roughly $50 off each model for the most affordable prices yet.

Of course, these aren't the biggest discounts, but keep in mind these machines just launched this week, so for anyone looking to buy early, they represent the cheapest options available right now:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (regularly $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (regularly $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (regularly $1,299)

While the launch deal on the 24GB M5 Pro Mac mini has yet to return, today we're also seeing a brand new 2026 Mac Studio with the M5 Max chip marked down by nearly $50:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (regularly $2,499)

All of the above deals represent the best cash discounts we've tracked to date.

Beats 360 ANC over-ear headphones launch deal: 20% off limited-edition Cushion Kits modular accessories for just $10

As we mentioned yesterday in our larger Beats promotion roundup, the Apple-owned brand has officially launched the new Beats 360 over-ear headphones, featuring modular ear cushions and headband pads. The product is now on sale, and we've also spotted a launch deal on the Beats 360 Cushion Kits in the form of a limited-time discount—marked down to $9.99.

Beats 360 launch deals

The all-new Beats 360 over-ear headphones feature a modular design that allows users to swap or replace the ear cushions and headband pads. The headphones themselves of course ship with a matching pair of Cushion Kits, but there are now seven different colors of Beats 360 Cushion Kits available to mix and match your style, or swap in a fresh pair of cushions after a workout.

  • Beats 360 over-ear headphones $350
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (regularly $50)

The Beats 360 Cushion Kit includes a pair of ear cushions and a headband pad. Six different Performance Knit styles are available, plus one UltraPlush option for users who prefer that classic Beats feel (with a hint of nostalgic leather).

The all-new Beats 360 serves as the flagship over-ear headphones in the lineup, offering "1.75 times more" noise cancellation than the Beats Studio Pro, personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking, beamforming microphones for calls that can filter out background noise, and an IPX4 water resistance rating—the Beats 360 is the brand's first over-ear headphones to feature sweat and water resistance. It also supports "Hey Siri" and Find My.

Mid-tier 13-inch M5 MacBook Air model now $150 off at Amazon

Beyond the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deals, Amazon is also giving you a chance to grab the mid-tier 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with $150 off.

Amazon has now cut the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and upgraded 1TB storage down to $1,449 with free shipping.

Regularly $1,599, this model is now $150 off, making it one of the best deals we've tracked since the price hike wave began a few months ago. Not all colors are marked down to this price, but you can snag the classic Silver, Sky Blue, and Starlight models for this price.

Speaking of the M5 MacBook Air lineup, any deal getting close to $150 off is a solid bet right now. While $100 off isn't bad, what we really want is something approaching $150 off, especially for any of the upgraded models.

The base model doesn't have any notable deals right now, but Amazon also has the 13-inch with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage listed for $1,649 with free shipping—also $150 below its regular price.

15-inch M5 MacBook Air models now up to $300 off at Apple Certified Refurbished store

While we're tracking $150 off the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air at Amazon today, if you act fast, the Apple Certified Refurbished store also has some solid deals on the 15-inch models—we're now seeing up to $300 off. Details below.

Act fast! Apple's Certified Refurbished store has the cheapest 2026 Studio Display at $240 off

Over the past few weeks, we've seen Amazon offering decent deals on the latest 2026 Apple Studio Display, but the Apple Certified Refurbished store is now slashing the entry-level model by $240 off its regular price.

The Apple Certified Refurbished store has now marked down the 2026 Apple Studio Display with tilt-adjustable stand to $1,359 with free shipping.
